headline: LeviLauncher Modder v1.5.27-modder.92
summary: Freeze sampler upgraded to nanosecond CPU precision and only tracks consistently-active threads; stall reports now include process-wide major page faults.

items.text: Thread freeze sampler now reads schedstat nanosecond CPU time (with utime/stime fallback), tracks only consistently-active game threads, and includes the process major-page-fault delta in stall reports to expose swap storms.
